text.arabic_uthmani: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍۢ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍۢ

words.gloss_range: Form X plural imperative of response and compliance, directed toward the addressees' Lord and bounded by the coming deadline
words.root_gloss_range: answering, responding, crossing into compliance; locally selected as Form X obedient response to the Lord-directed summons
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟}} ({{tr:istajībū}}) opens with the action still available: respond before the deadline is named. The plural imperative makes the hearers themselves the acting community, so no later individual refuge can undo collective nonresponse. Its Form X force makes response an entered compliance, not a bare verbal answer; because the verb takes the Lord-directed lām rather than an explicit object, the whole relation becomes the field of response, a movement from being addressed into obedience. The wider call-response register, including 2:186, 8:24, and the responder profile in 42:38, sharpens the command without changing the local demand.

topics.headline: opening command before the deadline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the only viable action placed first, before the ayah removes every later substitute.
topics.reason: The imperative morphology, opening position, temporal boundary, and boundary shift from 42:46 all support a direct summons before closure.

topics.headline: answer becomes obedient response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that response is not a mere spoken answer; it is compliance entered under the Lord-directed relation.
topics.reason: The Form X verb and lām complement select obedient response while keeping the answer/crossing pressure as local image, not an unrelated branch.

topics.headline: recognized call-response register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this command inside a wider Quranic call-response register, with 42:38 turning from model into direct summons here.
topics.reason: Rows with 2:186, 8:24, 42:38, and 46:31 preserve an echo field without making those passages control the local parse.

words.gloss_range: prefixed lām marking the direction and obligation of response toward the following Lord-title
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) immediately aims the command toward the Lord-title that follows. The response is therefore relational and owed, not a floating answer to an unnamed object.

topics.headline: lām directs the response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the response immediately aimed toward the Lord rather than left as an unspecified reply.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition is syntactically attached to the Lord-title and governed by the response command.

words.gloss_range: possessive relational Lord-title, binding the addressees to the one who sustains, owns, and commands them
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, nurture, ownership, governing, and formative authority; locally narrowed to the addressees' own Lord as the target of response
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّكُم}} ({{tr:rabbikum}}) makes the summoned authority personally relational: the plural suffix places the same audience inside the title. The root pressure of nurture, ownership, and rule makes nonresponse feel like a breach of dependence, while the ayah's later divine name turns this Lord-relation into the source of finality.

topics.headline: the addressees are bound to their Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is addressed through an already assigned relation, not through an abstract authority claim.
topics.reason: The genitive noun after lām and the plural suffix bind the same audience from the imperative to the Lord-title.

topics.headline: lordship carries nurture and rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels refusal as a breach of dependence on the one who sustains and governs, not merely resistance to force.
topics.reason: The root field of nurture, ownership, and rule survives as local relational pressure, while grammar keeps the title as the response target.

topics.headline: Lord-title opens what the divine name later seals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a title movement: Lord-relation opens the appeal, and the divine name later seals the no-return verdict.
topics.reason: Same-surah and wider lordship rows support a local title thread, with 42:38 and 1:2 functioning as references rather than replacement contexts.

words.gloss_range: preposition opening the temporal boundary phrase, separating the response window from what comes after it
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the threshold phrase. It puts the command on the near side of a boundary, so response sounds like action within a remaining interval rather than general advice.

topics.headline: min opens a bounded before-zone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the command as a countdown inside a bounded interval rather than timeless advice.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the temporal phrase and separates the present response-side from the coming event-side.

words.gloss_range: temporal before-threshold governed by min and completed by the coming-event clause
words.root_gloss_range: before-ness, facing, receiving, and coming-to-meet pressure; locally selected as the temporal front side before the coming event
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلِ}} ({{tr:qabli}}) turns that interval into a precise before-zone governed by the coming event. Its facing and receiving root-pressure makes time feel like the front side where response can still meet the summons, while the local noun keeps the sense temporal, not an acceptance verb. The familiar before-a-coming-day warning pattern is sharpened here because the required action is response to the Lord before the day is defined by no return.

topics.headline: before-ness is completed by the coming event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the response window defined by one coming event, not by vague pious timing.
topics.reason: The genitive noun is governed by min and in turn governs the following event clause, making the threshold syntactically precise.

topics.headline: time becomes the front side of encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels before-time as the facing side where the summons can still be received before closure.
topics.reason: The root's facing and receiving fields survive as image-pressure, while the local noun selects temporal before-ness rather than an acceptance verb.

topics.headline: before a coming day belongs to warning language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a familiar warning pattern sharpened by this ayah's irreversible day.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and formula rows support the deadline relation without adding a separate local sense.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle that projects the coming day as the event before which response still matters
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) opens the projected event clause after the before-threshold. The day is not narrated as already here; grammar keeps it impending, which leaves the command morally active for the present moment.

topics.headline: the event is subordinated and not yet arrived
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the remaining moral interval: the day is projected as coming, not narrated as already closed.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the subjunctive event clause under the before-threshold.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive imperfect arrival verb, with the day itself as the approaching subject
words.root_gloss_range: coming, reaching, arriving, bringing, and occurring; locally narrowed to intransitive event-arrival with the day as subject
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِىَ}} ({{tr:yaʾtiya}}) makes arrival the next motion in the ayah. The subjunctive form keeps it inside the before-clause, while the intransitive construction lets the day itself come toward the hearers; after the imperative assigns action to them, this verb shifts agency to an event they will not control. The day-arrival wording belongs to a warning register of divine events arriving, with 16:1 as a pressure point, but the local syntax narrows the root to event-arrival rather than bringing or bestowal.

topics.headline: arrival remains inside the before-clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears imminence without completion, which keeps response urgently possible for the moment.
topics.reason: The imperfect subjunctive after the subordinator keeps the arrival dependent on the temporal phrase.

topics.headline: the day itself comes toward them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees agency shift from commanded humans to an approaching event they will not control after it arrives.
topics.reason: The local construction is intransitive event-arrival with the day as subject, not object-bringing or bestowal.

topics.headline: arrival belongs to a warning register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the day-arrival phrase as part of a recognized warning register, while this ayah specializes it with no-return.
topics.reason: The rows preserve day-arrival and divine-event echoes, including 16:1, without overriding the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: indefinite arriving event-day, initially unspecific and then defined by irreversibility
words.root_gloss_range: day, occasion, and decisive event-time; locally narrowed to an arriving event-time defined by no return and later resumed by the adverbial compound
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمٌ}} ({{tr:yawmun}}) is not just a time label; it is the subject that arrives. Its indefiniteness first withholds full recognition, then the no-return phrase defines it by irreversibility. The same event-time later returns in the anaphoric compound, so the day that comes is also the container where refuge and denial fail. The familiar judgment-day negation frame, seen with ransom and intercession in 2:48, is specialized here into no reversal, no refuge, and no denial.

topics.headline: the day is the actor of arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that time is not only a setting; the day arrives and triggers the ayah's closure sequence.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative subject of the arrival verb and antecedent of the later pronoun.

topics.headline: indefiniteness lets no-return define the day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels dread build as an initially unspecific day is defined by irreversibility.
topics.reason: The bare indefinite event-time is narrowed locally by the no-return qualification, not treated as an ordinary calendar day.

topics.headline: the same day becomes later consequence-time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one event-time from arriving subject to the later time when refuge and denial fail.
topics.reason: Local repetition and same-surah rows support continuity between this day and the later anaphoric compound.

topics.headline: judgment-day language becomes recourse-collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the familiar judgment-day frame specialized here as no reversal, no refuge, and no denial.
topics.reason: The 2:48 and root-pair rows preserve a warning-frame echo while the local negations define this ayah's payoff.

words.gloss_range: categorical negation before the return noun, denying the genus of reversal rather than the day's arrival
words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) does not cancel the day's coming; it cancels reversal. The first negation therefore begins the stripping of recourse: arrival stands, while the genus of return is denied.

topics.headline: negation targets reversal, not arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears arrival as assumed while the entire class of reversal is denied.
topics.reason: The particle governs the return noun under categorical negation and launches the chain of recourse losses.

words.gloss_range: negated noun of return, repulsion, or rollback; locally no return-route exists for the day from God
words.root_gloss_range: returning, repelling, turning back, rejecting, and refuting; locally narrowed to any route or possibility of rollback for the arriving day
words.prose: {{ar:مَرَدَّ}} ({{tr:maradda}}) names the first missing recourse, a route or possibility of return. The doubled root keeps it in the return and repulsion field, not rebellion, and the categorical negation makes rollback unavailable. The no-repelling formula in 13:11 helps cast this as unappealable from God, while the return question in 42:44 is answered here by categorical denial. Its placement starts the ordered closure: no reversal for the event, then no shelter, then no protest.

topics.headline: no route of return exists
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reversal treated as a missing route or possibility, not as one failed attempt.
topics.reason: The accusative meem noun under categorical negation denies any instance of return and confirms the corrected root.

topics.headline: rollback and counter-claim collapse together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the denied return-route include rollback, repulsion, and argumentative reversal, while the local clause keeps event return primary.
topics.reason: The broader root pressure survives, but local grammar selects the day's no-return route rather than every root branch equally.

topics.headline: first recourse loss starts the ordered closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the first loss in a sequence: no event reversal, then no shelter, then no protest.
topics.reason: The complements tie the noun to the day and divine source, while 13:11 and 42:44 rows support an unappealable no-return echo.

words.gloss_range: lām plus pronoun assigning the denied return-route back to the arriving day
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) routes the denied return back to the day itself. The phrase prevents the reader from hearing no-return only as human weakness; the arriving day is the thing for which no return-route exists.

topics.headline: the pronoun gives the day no return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees no-return assigned to the arriving day itself before the divine source phrase closes the claim.
topics.reason: The pronoun most directly resumes the day and links the denied return noun to the source phrase.

words.gloss_range: source or separation preposition sealing the no-return phrase with divine sourcehood
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) asks where reversal could come from and seals the answer with divine sourcehood. Whether heard as source or separation, it makes the no-return verdict unappealable rather than merely difficult.

topics.headline: source min makes finality unappealable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader asks where reversal could come from and hears that no reversal issues from God or separates from His decree.
topics.reason: The preposition before the divine name marks source or separation at the end of the no-return clause.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in the source phrase, joining the earlier Lord-address to unappealable finality
words.root_gloss_range: deity and worship-field around the divine name, with derivational discussions of worship and bewilderment; locally the proper divine name marks unappealable source
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāh}}) closes the no-return phrase with the proper divine name. The ayah has moved from the addressees' Lord at the summons to God as the source before whom reversal fails, so relation and finality belong to the same divine referent. The deity and worship field makes the source phrase divine-authority language rather than fate or vague power; derivational bewilderment remains only as pressure around rollback schemes becoming unavailable, while the local form remains the proper name in a source phrase.

topics.headline: the Lord of response is the God of finality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees no split between the relational Lord who summons and the divine source who makes return impossible.
topics.reason: The divine name completes the source phrase and connects the earlier Lord-title with the no-return seal.

topics.headline: proper divine name resists dilution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source phrase as divine-authority language rather than fate or a vague power.
topics.reason: Derivational and deity-field pressure survives as authority texture, while the local form is the proper divine name in genitive after the source preposition.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the first human no-resource clause after the divine-source seal
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the first human lack clause after the divine-source seal. The grammar turns from what the day lacks to what the addressees do not have available.

topics.headline: negative mā opens human lack
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the grammar turn from the day's no-return to the addressees' unavailable resources.
topics.reason: The particle opens a negated existential clause with fronted availability, not a question or relative construction.

words.gloss_range: fronted availability phrase, making the addressees themselves the domain where refuge is absent
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) puts the audience first in the no-resource clause. Before the missing refuge is named, the hearers themselves are made the domain where no usable access remains.

topics.headline: the addressees become the lack-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audience placed first in the lack clause before the missing refuge is named.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional pronoun functions as the predicate of the negated existential clause.

words.gloss_range: min after negation, denying even a minimal instance of refuge
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the refuge denial exhaustive. It leaves no minimum share or single instance of shelter outside the negation and prepares the repeated no-resource frame at the end.

topics.headline: even one refuge is excluded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears no residual opening for even a minimal shelter or fallback.
topics.reason: The particle before the indefinite refuge noun strengthens negation and prepares the repeated no-resource frame.

words.gloss_range: indefinite concrete refuge or resort noun under exhaustive negation; no shelter, asylum, or fallback remains
words.root_gloss_range: seeking refuge, resorting, shelter, asylum, and compelled fallback; locally narrowed to a concrete missing place or recourse of refuge
words.prose: {{ar:مَّلْجَإٍ}} ({{tr:maljaʾin}}) concretizes the second loss as a missing shelter, resort, or fallback. The noun-of-place form and rare refuge root make the absence vivid, while the min-negation denies even one such place. In the ayah's sequence, failed protection in 42:46 and no reversal give way to no spatial or social refuge before speech-based protest is removed; the refuge-seeking possibility in 9:57 is reversed here into a no-refuge verdict under divine finality.

topics.headline: the syntax denies any refuge whatever
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the missing shelter as total, not merely the loss of one known escape.
topics.reason: The indefinite genitive noun under min after negation completes the no-resource construction.

topics.headline: rare place-noun makes refuge concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines a missing shelter or resort, not just an abstract comfort.
topics.reason: The noun-of-place form and rare root make recourse concrete, while local negation keeps it unavailable.

topics.headline: shelter collapses between no-return and no-protest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the ordered collapse from failed protection and no reversal into no spatial or social refuge.
topics.reason: Boundary rows, 9:57, and the paired closing pattern support refuge as the middle recourse loss before final protest is denied.

words.gloss_range: anaphoric event-time adverb, locating the no-refuge and no-denial losses inside that already named day
words.root_gloss_range: day and decisive event-time; locally repeated in a compound that points back to the already arriving day
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَئِذٍ}} ({{tr:yawmaʾidhin}}) folds the no-refuge clause back into the already named arriving day. The compound does not start a new scene; it points to that event-time and, by its placement, bridges no refuge and no denial under one temporal condition. The contrast with 82:19 is useful: command belongs to God that day, while here human recourse disappears that day.

topics.headline: that-day points back to the arriving day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows the no-refuge scene is not new; it is located inside the very day already introduced.
topics.reason: The compound form carries an anaphoric pointer back to the prior arrival event.

topics.headline: the adverb bridges refuge and denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears no refuge and no denial as belonging to one event-time condition.
topics.reason: Its placement after the refuge noun and before the coordinated no-denial clause lets the temporal condition color both losses.

topics.headline: same day-thread returns with human lack
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same event-day thread turn from the day that comes into the time when human recourse fails; 82:19 supplies a contrast where command belongs to God that day.
topics.reason: The rows preserve 82:19 and same-surah event-day echoes as contrast and continuity, not as a different local parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding the no-denial clause to the no-refuge clause as a cumulative pair
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the final no-denial clause to the no-refuge clause. The second loss is coordinated as a partner in the same closing pair, not added loosely afterward.

topics.headline: wāw binds no-denial to no-refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second loss as a coordinated partner to no refuge, not an afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second negated existential clause with the first.

words.gloss_range: repeated negative particle restarting the same no-resource frame for protest or denial
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) restarts the same negative availability frame. The repetition makes protest fall under the same grammar as refuge, so the final loss is not weaker or merely figurative.

topics.headline: the second mā restarts the same lack grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees protest denied under the same grammar as refuge, making it an equivalent resource-loss.
topics.reason: The repeated negative particle opens a parallel possession or availability denial.

words.gloss_range: repeated fronted availability phrase, keeping the same addressees exposed as the denied resource shifts from shelter to protest
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) repeats the exposed audience before the final missing resource. What was unavailable as shelter is now unavailable as speech-based defense, and the boundary pressure from 42:46 turns a described verdict into direct address: for you.

topics.headline: the same audience remains exposed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the addressees inside both losses as the denied resource shifts from shelter to speech-based defense.
topics.reason: The repeated fronted phrase mirrors the earlier no-refuge clause while changing the missing resource.

topics.headline: third-person verdict becomes second-person exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prior described group carried into direct address: the lack is now for you.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the preceding third-person verdict to the present second-person warning.

words.gloss_range: min after negation before the final denial noun, excluding even one instance or channel of protest
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) repeats the exhaustive frame before the final noun. It denies even one channel, token, or share of protest, matching the earlier refuge denial.

topics.headline: even one protest channel is excluded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears no residual part, share, or token of denial left available.
topics.reason: The second min repeats the exhaustive frame before the indefinite denial noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite denial or repudiation noun under exhaustive negation; no protest, disavowal, or denier remains available
words.root_gloss_range: denying, repudiating, disguising, nonrecognition, and finding objectionable; locally narrowed to any protest, denial, or repudiating counter-stance
words.prose: {{ar:نَّكِيرٍ}} ({{tr:nakīrin}}) closes the ayah by removing denial itself. The root field of nonrecognition, repudiation, and finding strange survives in the final noun, but the local construction makes that whole counter-stance unavailable as a resource. The sequence now completes its stripping of recourse: no rollback, no shelter, and finally no protest.

topics.headline: syntax denies any instance of protest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees denial itself, including act and possible denier, removed as an available resource.
topics.reason: The indefinite abstract noun fills the same min-governed slot as the refuge noun and is denied under the repeated frame.

topics.headline: nonrecognition and repudiation fail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the last strategy of making the judgment strange, false, or disowned collapse.
topics.reason: The root field of denial and nonrecognition survives, while local syntax selects an unavailable resource noun rather than a finite denying act.

topics.headline: the ayah closes on speech-collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the final step in the chain: after no reversal and no shelter, even protest has no route.
topics.reason: The final position, paired cadence, 42:46 boundary rows, and local pairing with the return noun support closure on collapsed protest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative, its Lord-directed complement, and the before/arrival construction make the present a still-open answering interval.
baseline_models.mechanism: A verbal answer is owed to the one who owns and progressively tends the addressees. The severe day is pictured as approaching; response belongs to the interval before its arrival.

activation_trace.role: The reply branch makes the imperative an active answering turn rather than silent assent.
Progressive tending and completion identify the addressee's counterpart as the one already forming them.
Advance and approach turn the temporal marker into a shrinking interval ahead of arrival.
Concrete arrival supplies the event toward which the interval is moving.
The day as a severe occurrence gives the approaching endpoint its event-force.

changed_reading.before: A generic command to obey before a future judgment.
changed_reading.after: Use the remaining dialogic turn to answer the Lord who has been tending you before the approaching event ends that interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated negatives remove return or repulsion, refuge, and denial or redress.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse closes three different escape systems in sequence: motion cannot be reversed or deflected, space offers no shelter, and discourse cannot deny, disguise, or correct the event. The imperative precedes this total closure.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior place or state supplies the temporal and directional escape that is removed.
Deflection and prevention supply the counterforce that can no longer stop the event.
Protective shelter supplies the spatial option explicitly denied.
Nonrecognition and repudiation supply the discursive option explicitly denied.
Redress of a rejected wrong adds the unavailable corrective option.

changed_reading.before: A list of roughly synonymous threats about having nowhere to go.
changed_reading.after: A coordinated closure of reversal, shelter, and rebuttal makes present response the last live move.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The response root's aperture branch meets the facing and capacity branches of the before-root, while the verse later denies refuge.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant but focus-anchored image treats response as cutting an opening by facing the address while one still has capacity to meet it. That opening must be made now because the later scene supplies neither deflection nor protected space.

activation_trace.role: An aperture or cleared middle gives response a spatial image of making passage.
Face-to-face orientation supplies the direction in which the opening is made.
Capacity to confront something makes the present interval one of remaining ability, not time alone.
The denied shelter gives the exploratory opening image real spatial stakes.

changed_reading.before: Respond verbally while there is still time.
changed_reading.after: Turn toward the address and open a passage through it while capacity remains; later there is neither passage-making room nor shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah sequences divine acceptance, answering by believers, increase, and a later Lord-directed response embodied in practice. The focus imperative therefore enters an already active economy of reception and answer rather than initiating an isolated demand.

activation_trace.role: The focus imperative asks the addressees to take their answering turn.
Willing reception establishes acceptance on the divine side of the sequence.
Answering reappears immediately after acceptance, making the two acts sequentially adjacent.
Growth and addition make answering productive rather than merely compliant.
The repeated answer is explicitly directed to the Lord and then unfolded in communal acts.

structural_cues: 42:25-26 places acceptance, answering, and increase in immediate sequence.
42:38 repeats the same Lord-directed response before listing prayer, consultation, and expenditure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceptance, answer, increase, and repeated Lord-directed response; I supply the reciprocal-cycle arrow. A live alternative is that 42:26 merely coordinates human response with divine increase without implying a two-sided cycle.

changed_reading.before: The Lord issues a one-way demand for compliance.
changed_reading.after: The imperative asks the hearers to enter a reciprocal sequence already marked by acceptance, answer, increase, and repeated response.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior word defers decision to a fixed term; the hour is then near, some try to hasten it, and a separating decision remains decisive. The focus's before-construction marks a bounded and usable reprieve inside ordered timing, not an arbitrary surprise.

activation_trace.role: Advance and approach make the focus interval directional and finite.
Arrival closes the interval whose prior ordering the context reveals.
Precedence places a prior determination before the deferred decision.
A fixed temporal limit makes postponement bounded rather than indefinite.
A cutting judgment identifies what the bounded delay temporarily withholds.
Temporal nearness tightens the available interval.
Hastening supplies the wrong attempt to manipulate the ordered endpoint.
Decisive separation defines the closure waiting beyond the reprieve.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a named term at 42:14 to nearness and attempted hastening at 42:17-18.
The deferred decision at 42:21 and irreversible arrival at 42:47 frame the intervening span as actionable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precedence, a fixed term, nearness, hastening, and decisive separation; I infer that their interval functions as a deliberate reprieve for response. It could instead mark decree without implying that the delay itself is invitational.

changed_reading.before: Respond quickly because an unpredictable deadline may suddenly arrive.
changed_reading.after: Respond within a deliberately bounded interval whose end is ordered, near, and irreversible, rather than trying to hurry or evade that end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier Lord-directed response is immediately realized as worship, extracted shared judgment, and outward expenditure; the following sequence regulates injury through pardon, repair, and resolved restraint. These acts form a present social holding structure, which sharply contrasts with the focus's later absence of refuge.

activation_trace.role: The focus command recalls an earlier response whose practical contents are supplied by context.
The denied later shelter creates the contrast with present relational practices.
Answering is the heading under which the verse's communal practices appear.
Binding worship supplies durable vertical alignment within the response.
Extracting judgment through review supplies collective decision-making.
Resources moving outward supply material support rather than private retention.
Withheld punishment opens a way to stop injury from reproducing itself.
Repair that removes estrangement gives pardon a social mechanism.

structural_cues: 42:38 grammatically places prayer, consultation, and spending after the Lord-directed response.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies linked practices and the later denial of refuge; I infer that the practices function analogically as a present social holding structure. They may instead remain a virtue list with no refuge function.

changed_reading.before: Response is a private inward act undertaken before solitary judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first removes lateral evasion, turns the route into legal exposure, voices a wish for a return-route, and then denies any route. After the focus it positively names guided straight passage and the destination of all affairs. Response becomes entry into the disclosed trajectory before evasive paths and return close.

activation_trace.role: Facing supplies the orientation required to enter a trajectory.

The absence of shelter prevents route choice from ending in a hiding place.
Turning aside from direction supplies the earliest unavailable lateral escape.

The requested return makes reversal the condemned speakers' explicit desire.
The desired reversal is specifically imagined as a route.
The route is denied immediately before the focus repeats the closure as no return and no refuge.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the positive alternative after evasive routes close.
The straight road identifies the trajectory into which response can be read as entry.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies convergence at the surah's final destination.

structural_cues: 42:35, 42:41-42, 42:44, and 42:46 successively vary escape, legal route, return-route, and no route.
42:52-53 follows the focus with guidance, a straight road, and the convergence of all affairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the route-chain and final convergence; I supply the arrow that answering the Lord means entering the offered trajectory. The final road may instead orient the revelation generally without specifically glossing the focus imperative.

changed_reading.before: Respond now because there will be no escape route later.
changed_reading.after: Face and enter the one disclosed trajectory now: lateral evasion, legal escape, and reversal all close while every affair is already converging on the same destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth and measure establish a stable record; falsehood loses its trace while inward sources are known; the condemned are then displayed even as they attempt a hidden look. Against that sequence, the focus's lack of denial closes not only verbal repudiation but also disguise, reclassification, and corrective protest.

activation_trace.role: Nonrecognition and repudiation supply the basic forensic defense that fails.
Changing something until it is unrecognizable supplies the failed strategy of disguise or relabeling.
Redress of recognized wrong supplies the corrective protest that is no longer available.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard against which denial fails.
Just measure gives the exposure an evaluative instrument.

The establishment and manifestation of truth replaces the erased alternative.
The inward source from which acts issue prevents merely external relabeling.
Being brought out for view makes the judgment publicly inspectable.
Attempted concealment survives only as a diminished way of looking, not as protection from exposure.
Comprehensive loss is the declared result once concealment and denial fail.

structural_cues: 42:17 joins truth and measure; 42:24 removes falsehood, establishes truth, and reaches inward sources.
42:45 shifts from hidden inwardness to public display and a furtive gaze immediately before the no-denial clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable truth, measure, inner knowledge, display, concealment, and loss; I infer a forensic chain in which denial cannot alter the record. The final noun may have a narrower force such as repudiation, disapproval, or avenging redress.

changed_reading.before: There will be no one able to deny that the day occurred.
changed_reading.after: Once truth, measure, inward motive, and public exposure align, no denial can disguise the known record, reclassify it, or mount corrective protest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early and immediately post-focus passages deny that the messenger is the addressees' guardian or managing protector and reduce his compulsory role to delivery. The focus therefore demands a direct, nontransferable answer to their Lord; no human intermediary can later become the refuge the verse denies.

activation_trace.role: Answering is assigned directly to the plural addressees.

structural_cues: 42:6 and 42:48 bracket the surah with parallel limits on messenger guardianship.
42:48 immediately contrasts turning away with the focus command and states that only delivery rests on the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct address, repeated role limits, turning away, and delivery; I infer that response cannot be delegated and that the messenger cannot function as later shelter. The passages may only delimit messenger responsibility without defining the hearer's response mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Heed the messenger's warning so that his authority can secure you.
changed_reading.after: Answer your Lord yourselves: the messenger can deliver the address but cannot answer for you, manage you into safety, or become your refuge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's non-dominant split mapping to a vessel-pushing implement. It remains valid as an analogy because that exact packet branch is anchored at the focus and the surah supplies ships, wind-loss, stillness, and wrecking in sequence. Downstream prose must label it a branch-activated maritime image, never the lexical gloss of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denies a return or repelling force and a refuge; its split branch can image a vessel with neither propulsion nor haven.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapping supplies a pole that pushes a vessel, allowing absent propulsion to color the denied counter-move.
Denied shelter becomes the missing haven in the contained maritime analogy.
Flowing motion establishes vessels as moving bodies before immobilization.
Wide water supplies the exposed medium in which propulsion and haven matter.
Loss of motion initiates the vessel's helpless state.

Destruction supplies the terminal risk once movement cannot be recovered.

changed_reading.before: Respond before a day on which no abstract reversal or refuge exists.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, respond while movement and steerage remain, before the vessel-like scene loses wind, counter-push, and haven and proceeds toward wrecking.

strongest_changes: The imperative enters a surah-wide sequence of acceptance, answer, increase, and repeated Lord-directed response.
The before-clause becomes a measured reprieve bounded by term, nearness, and decisive separation.
The local chain closes evasion, legal escape, return-route, and refuge before the ending names the guided straight trajectory and common destination.
Repeated limits on messenger guardianship make the required answer direct and nondelegable.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the focus from an isolated warning into a junction of reciprocal answer, timed reprieve, social practice, route convergence, and exposed accountability; the packet's split root also preserved a contained maritime outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal force of 42:26 depends on how its answering clause relates to the following increase.
The social-refuge model is a functional analogy, not an explicit identification of the community as shelter.
The final denial-root may privilege repudiation, disguise, disapproval, or corrective redress.
The maritime model is deliberately form-distant and must remain exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Response must traverse the address before the irreversible event arrives.** Lexical evidence: ج و ب `B001` (cutting through) and `B003` (answering), ق ب ل `B002` (priorness), ء ت ي `B001` (arrival), ي و م `B003` (severe event-day), and ر د د `B001` (returning). Structural cue and role: the imperative is bounded by **مِن قَبْلِ**; afterward the day itself admits no return. Abductive move: I infer that answering now cuts a viable passage which the event's arrival closes. Reading change: urgency is channel-specific, not mere alarm.

2. **Neither outer refuge nor discursive denial remains.** Lexical evidence: ل ج ء `B001` (resorting to refuge), ن ك ر `B001` (non-acknowledgment) and `B007` (hostile opposition). Structural cue and role: the closing parallel negations remove both a place to flee and a stance from which to repudiate. Abductive move: I infer that the event closes spatial and rhetorical exits together. Reading change: accountability is total because neither body nor speech can relocate it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:51–52 supply the content and channel of the response: authorized revelation becomes spirit, light, and guidance. The later sequence makes the present imperative an answer to mediated speech, not an unspecified demand.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Response is the open interface before irreversible arrival.** **Lexical evidence:** ج و ب `B003` (responsive compliance), ق ب ل `B002` (priorness), ء ت ي `B001` (coming and arriving), and ر د د `B001` (returning or sending back), anchored in ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ ... مِن قَبْلِ ... لَّا مَرَدَّ. **Structural cue:** 42:44 asked for a return route after sight; 42:46 denied any route; the fixed imperative relocates action to the interval before arrival, while 42:48 presents turning away as its opposite. **Assigned role:** response uses the remaining temporal opening; arrival closes reversibility. **Abductive move:** I infer that "before" is the only live interface in the sequence, not incidental timing. **Reading change:** the imperative is an urgent entry into dialogue before a state transition becomes one-way.
2. **The final condition removes refuge and the power to disown the result.** **Lexical evidence:** ل ج ء `B001` (resorting to a refuge) and ن ك ر `B001` (denial, disavowal, or non-acknowledgement), anchored in مَّلْجَإٍ and نَّكِيرٍ. **Structural cue:** 42:42 established valid liability, and 42:44-46 successively removed patronage and route. **Assigned role:** refuge would change location; disavowal would change attribution; both are denied. **Abductive move:** I infer that spatial escape and narrative denial are paired fallback strategies. **Reading change:** the day closes not only movement but the ability to redescribe whose consequence it is.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:48's turning away is the immediate opposite of commanded response. 42:51-52 then revealed what response answers: authorized speech that arrives as spirit, light, and guidance, making the pre-closure interface communicative rather than merely temporal.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Forgetting the meeting of this day is answered by being forgotten and tasting the lasting punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts wrongdoers before their Lord after the promise has come true, blaming one another too late.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The people of the Fire call for release to act righteously, and are answered that their warning period was sufficient.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The soul's regret for neglecting its duty to God gives voice to the missed opportunity before final judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It records the later claim that guidance would have made the speaker among the God-conscious.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Seeing punishment, the speaker wishes for another return in order to do good.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It recalls that people were called to faith but disbelieved, directly identifying the earlier refused summons.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The people of the Fire acknowledge death and life and ask for a way out, an especially close counterpart to no refuge and no denial.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Fire's inhabitants dispute responsibility after punishment, showing the futility of post-judgment argument.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those followed deny that they can avert any portion of the Fire from their followers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows the wrongdoers exposed to the Fire and defines true loss as loss on the Day of Resurrection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The guilty remain in the punishment of Hell without relief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A barrier closes off hypocrites seeking the believers' light, a vivid image of irreversible exclusion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelievers are told not to make excuses that day, directly paralleling the loss of any denial or revision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: No intimate friend will ask after an intimate friend on the day of judgment, extending the focus's absence of refuge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The guilty person would ransom himself with children, spouse, brother, and all on earth, yet cannot escape.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It commands fear of the day of return to God, when every soul is fully repaid for what it earned.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: On the day each soul finds its deeds present, the evildoer wishes a vast distance between itself and its evil.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Neither earth's fill of gold nor any ransom is accepted from those who disbelieve and die in that state.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Even all that is on earth twice over cannot ransom the disbelievers from the punishment of the day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Being set before their Lord makes the denied reality undeniable, directly anticipating the focus's loss of denial.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The gathering day compresses worldly life to a brief encounter and exposes mutual recognition among those who denied meeting God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names the day when humanity will be gathered and witnessed, strengthening the focus's announced day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: All appear before God, and followers learn that those they relied on cannot avert any part of God's punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It warns not to think God unaware of wrongdoers, but delaying them to the day when eyes will stare.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: On the transformed earth and heavens, people emerge before the One, the Overpowering.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Every person's record is fastened to them and will be produced open on the Day of Resurrection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It commands warning of the Day of Regret, when the matter is decided while people had remained heedless.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: All faces are humbled before the Ever-Living Sustainer, and the bearer of wrongdoing fails.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: When the trumpet is blown, kinship ties and mutual inquiry no longer operate among people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Cast bound into a narrow place in the Fire, its people call out for destruction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: On the Hour's arrival, the guilty fall into despair.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The disbelievers in the Fire are neither allowed to die nor is its punishment lightened for them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: On that day no soul is wronged at all; each is repaid only for what it did.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to separate from the criminals on that day makes final division explicit.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies Hell as the one promised to persistent deniers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The disbelievers are driven to Hell in groups after its gates are opened and their warnings recalled.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: On the day people emerge, nothing about them is hidden from God and all dominion is His alone.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Whether they endure or plead, the Fire remains their lodging and no appeal is accepted.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It warns wrongdoers of the punishment of a painful day after their dispute divided them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's dominion over heaven and earth culminates in the day the Hour rises, when falsifiers lose.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: No angelic intercession avails except after God's permission, reinforcing the lack of independent recourse.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The human being asks on that day where there is any escape.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It answers that there is no refuge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It fixes the destination on that day as return to the Lord.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Receiving one's record from behind one's back depicts the condemned side of final accounting.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyi delip geçecek biçimde kesmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir; kaya oyma, yer kazma, giysi açıklığı açma ve boynuzun deriyi yararak çıkması bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu işlem ve sonuç ilişkisini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, nesnede geçişli bir yarma veya kesme işlemiyle sınırlıdır; yer aşma, sözlü karşılık ve yalnızca oluşmuş boşluk bu çekirdeğe girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel delip kesme çekirdeğini, belirli yapılara bağlı giysi, kazma ve boynuz örneklerinden ayırır; bu özel kullanımlar yalın anlamın tamamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yarıp öte yanına geçecek biçimde kesmek veya delmek; kaya oyma ve yer kazma bunun sert yüzey ya da zemin üzerindeki özel gerçekleşmeleridir. Giyside açıklık oluşturma ile boynuzun deriyi yararak dışarı çıkması da aynı geçişli yarılma düzenine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi, içinde geçişli bir açıklık oluşacak biçimde yarma, delme veya kesme işlemi.
Kayayı oyarak kesme ya da bir yeri kazıp çukurlaştırma, çekirdek işlemin sert yüzey ve zemin üzerindeki özel biçimleridir.
Giyside yaka açıklığı açmak ve boynuzun deriyi delerek çıkması, geçişli yarılmanın somut örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı delme ile kesmeyi tek bir geçişli işlemde birleştirir; giysi biçme, kaya oyma, kazma ve deriyi yararak çıkma bu işlemin farklı nesnelerdeki görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın tüm özel gerçekleşmelerini yöneten geçişli yarma ve kesme çekirdeği için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kesme işlemini hem de açıklığın öte yana geçmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaya ya da zemin üzerinde oyma ve kazma yoluyla açıklık oluşturulan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sert bir yüzeyde keserek veya kazarak açıklık oluşturmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Giysi kesme ve deriyi yararak çıkma gibi öteki gerçekleşmeleri dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Boynuz gibi bir parçanın deriyi delerek dışarı çıktığı bağlam için doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir engeli yararak öte yana çıkma düzenini korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan eliyle yapılan kesme, oyma ve kazma kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi delip geçecek biçimde kesmek

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi ayırmaya yönelik kesme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kesmenin geçişli bir delik veya açıklık oluşturması koşulunu siler.
error_profile.collision: Her türlü yüzeysel veya bütünüyle ayıran kesme için de kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnede öte yana geçen bir açıklık oluşturmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynağın açıkça taşıdığı kesme ve oyma işlemlerini tek başına belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı yer, ıssız alan, ülke ve geceyi baştan başa geçme hareketini; ayrıca bir ülkeden ötekine taşınan haberi aynı yol aşma düzeninde toplar. Sağlanan çerçeve hareket eden kişi ile taşınan haber arasındaki katılımcı değişimini de korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir alanı yol alarak aşmaktır; nesneyi fiziksel olarak delip kesme ve sözlü karşılık verme bu dala alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yer aşma kullanımı, gece boyunca ilerleme ve haberin ülkeler arasında taşınması gibi yapıya bağlı uzantılardan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yeri, ülkeyi ya da karanlık bir zaman aralığını yol alarak baştan başa geçmek. Aynı hareket düzeni, bir haberin uzak yerler arasında taşınmasına aktarılarak kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir yeri veya ülkeyi yol alıp bir ucundan öteki ucuna geçerek aşma.
Bütün gece ilerlemek veya karanlığı yararak yol almak, alan aşma çekirdeğinin zamansal ve görsel olarak belirlenmiş biçimidir.
Haberin bir ülkeden ötekine taşınması, yol aşan kişinin hareketinin taşınan bilgiye aktarılmış uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yer ve ülke aşmayı ortak çekirdek olarak sunar; sürekli yol alan kişi, gece boyunca ilerleme ve uzak yerlerden taşınan haber bu çekirdeğin katılımcı ya da kapsam uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan hareketini ve haberin yerler arasında taşınmasına aktarılan hareket düzenini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yol almayı, alanın aşılmasını ve bir uçtan ötekine geçişi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin yer veya ülke boyunca yol aldığı doğrudan hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alan boyunca ilerleme ve alanı aşma bileşenlerini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir haberin uzak yerler arasında aktarılması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberin bir yerden ötekine hareket ettirilmesini ve uzaklık aşmasını korur.

error_profile.collision: Amaçsız gezinme anlamıyla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal ıssız alanı yolculukla aşmaya bağlı daha dar bir kullanımdır; odak dal ise yer ve ülke geçişini geneller, ayrıca geceyi ve haberin taşınmasını kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı söze veya soruya karşılık verme, karşılıklı konuşma, çağrıya yönelme ve isteği yerine getirme kullanımlarını açıkça birlikte sunar. Dal çerçevesi yalnız söylenen cevabı değil, çağrıya kabul ve uyma yoluyla verilen karşılığı da kapsadığı için kaynağa uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği bir söz, soru, çağrı veya isteğe yöneltilmiş karşılıktır; yer aşma ve fiziksel kesme bu ilişkinin parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel karşılık verme çekirdeği, karşılıklı konuşma, çağrıya uyma ve yanlış işitmeye bağlı kalıplaşmış örneklerden ayrı katmanlarda tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir söze, soruya, çağrıya veya isteğe sözle ya da uygun eylemle karşılık vermek. Karşılıklı söz alışverişi bu işlemin iki yönlü biçimi, bir çağrıya uyma veya isteği yerine getirme ise eylemle gerçekleşen biçimidir.

facets.statement: Önceden yöneltilmiş bir söz veya soruya karşı söz üreterek karşılık verme.
Bir çağrıya yönelmek, ona uymak veya isteyenin dileğini yerine getirmek, karşılığın eylemle verilmiş uzantısıdır.
İki tarafın birbirine karşılık vererek konuşması, tek yönlü karşılığın karşılıklı konuşmaya genişlemiş biçimidir.
Yanlış işitmenin yanlış karşılığa yol açtığını anlatan kalıplaşmış söz, çekirdek ilişkinin sonuç bildiren bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılığı sözle verme ile çağrıya veya isteğe eylemle karşılık vermeyi aynı alanda toplar; karşılıklı konuşma iki tarafın art arda karşılık üretmesi olarak sunulur.

concept_gloss.text: söze ya da çağrıya karşılık verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlü cevap, karşılıklı konuşma ve çağrıya uygun eylemle yönelme kapsamlarının ortak çekirdeğini taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki söz veya çağrı ile ona yöneltilmiş sözlü ya da eylemsel karşılık ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir söz veya soruya sözle cevap verilen genel bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Olumsuz ya da yansız cevapları ve karşılıklı konuşmayı dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Söze karşılık verme ve konuşmanın taraflar arasında gidip gelmesi iki dalda ortaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca olumsuz bir sözü tersine çevirip olumlayan belirli cevap sözcüğüdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı yerdeki çukur veya açık alanı, bulut ve dağlardaki aralığı, ortası boş nesneyi ve açılıp genişleyen oluşumu birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bunların ortak sonucu olan açılmış ya da içi boşalmış alanı doğru biçimde yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal oluşmuş açıklık, geniş boşluk veya ortası boş durumla ilgilidir; bu sonucu doğuran kesme işlemi ve yalnızca bir yerde ilerleme ayrı kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın açıklık ve boşluk çekirdeğinde kalır; belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı ek bir okuma içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yerde, dağda, bulutta veya bir nesnenin ortasında açılmış, genişlemiş ya da boş kalmış alan. Bulutun açılması bu boşluğun oluşma sürecini, ortası oyuk nesne ise kalıcı sonucunu gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir yüzeyde veya iki bölüm arasında açılmış ve genişlemiş boşluk, aralık ya da çukur alan.
Yerdeki çukur alan ile bulut veya dağ arasındaki açıklık, çekirdeğin çevresel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Bir nesnenin ortasının boş veya oyuk olması, alansal açıklığın nesne yapısına uygulanmış uzantısıdır.
Bulutun açılıp dağılması, kapalı görünüm içinde bir açıklığın ortaya çıkma sürecidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yerdeki çukur alanı, bulut ve dağdaki aralığı ve ortası boş nesneyi genişlemiş açıklık ortaklığında birleştirir; bulutun dağılması bu açıklığın oluşmasını anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: açılmış ya da ortası boş geniş aralık
concept_gloss.applicability: Yerdeki çukur alanı, çevresel açıklığı ve nesnenin ortasındaki boşluğu birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Açılma, genişlik ve ortanın boş kalması bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yer, dağ veya bulut içinde belirgin bir aralık görüldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Açılmış alanın geniş ve boş oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesnenin ortasının oyuk olması ve bulutun açılma sürecini açıkça göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulut örtüsünün dağılıp arada açıklık belirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kapalı bulut görünümünün açılmasını ve açıklığın ortaya çıkmasını korur.

error_profile.loses: Geniş çukur alanı, dağ veya bulut aralığını ve ortası boş yapıyı daraltır.
error_profile.collision: Küçük ve dar bir geçit çağrışımıyla dalın genişlik sınırını bozar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki şey arasındaki yarığı, duvar ve giysi yırtığını ve yayın telden ayrılmasını ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki bölümün ayrılmasıyla arada açıklık veya boşluk oluşması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genişlemiş boşluğa ve ortası boş alana yönelir; komşu dalın merkezi iki şey arasındaki ayrılma çizgisi veya yarıktır ve daha çok yüzey türüne yayılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal oluşmuş geniş açıklığı, boşluğu veya çukur alanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir nesneyi delip geçerek kesme ve açıklığı meydana getirme işlemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir yüzeyin açılması ve boşluk oluşması iki dalı aynı sonuç zincirinde buluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal durum veya oluşmuş alan, komşu dal ise bunu doğurabilen geçişli işlemdir; sonuç ile işlem sıradan kullanımda birbirinin yerine geçmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı kadınların giydiği bir zırh veya giysiyi, kalkanı, kesilmiş bir üstlüğü ve giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini açıkça aynı dalda sıralar. Sağlanan çerçeve bu adlandırmaları tek nesneye indirgemeden koruduğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, giysi ve korunma nesnesi adları ile giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini kapsar; fiziksel kesme yalnız giysinin biçimini açıklayan arka plandır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda tanıklanan giysi, zırh ve kalkan adlarını temel alır; giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemi kaynakta verilen türemiş kullanım olarak ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Kadının giydiği zırh veya giysi, kesilmiş bir üstlük ya da savunmada kullanılan kalkan için kullanılan ad. Buna bağlı eylem, bir giysiyi bedene geçirip giymektir.

facets.statement: Kadının bedenine giydiği zırh veya koruyucu nitelikli giysi adı.
Aynı adın elde taşınan savunma aracı olan kalkanı belirtmesi ayrı bir nesne değeridir.
Kesilmiş bir tür üstlüğü belirtmesi, giysi alanındaki özel adlandırmadır.
Bir gömleği veya başka giysiyi bedene geçirip giymek, nesne adından ayrılan eylem kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kadın giysisi veya zırhı ile kalkanı ayrı nesne değerleri olarak verir; kesilmiş üstlük anlamı giysi alanını özelleştirir, giysiyi bedene geçirme ise eylem uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.text: giysi, zırh veya kalkan; giysiyi üstüne geçirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın birbirinden ayrılan nesne adlarını ve bunlara bağlı giyinme eylemini eksiltmeden birlikte gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak anlatımı ışık, açığa çıkarma ve belirginleştirme değerlerini yan yana verir; bu yüzden sağlanan dal bütünüyle reddedilemez. Ancak anlatım çok kısa olduğundan bu değerlerin tek bir işlem mi yoksa sıralı anlamlar mı olduğu kesinleştirilemez ve tanım yalnız açıkça verilen üçlüyle sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız ışık, açığa çıkarma ve belirginleştirme değerleriyle sınırlıdır; bunların ötesinde bir kullanım veya türetim varsayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ya da belirli bir yapıya bağlı kullanım olduğu varsayılmaz; tanım, kısa kaynak anlatımındaki üç değeri dilbilgisel kapsam yüklemeden korur.

concept_map.definition: Işık, gizli veya örtülü olanı açığa çıkarma ve belirsiz olanı belirginleştirme alanı. Kısa tanıklık, bu değerler arasındaki ilişkinin daha dar bir işlem dizisi olarak kurulmasına izin vermez.

facets.statement: Işık veya aydınlık değeri, kısa kaynak anlatımının doğrudan verdiği ilk bileşendir.
Örtülü olanı açığa çıkarma değeri, aynı kısa anlatımda ayrı bir bileşen olarak yer alır.
Belirsiz olanı açık ve seçilir duruma getirme değeri, anlatımın üçüncü bileşenidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal tek ve çok kısa bir tanıklığa dayanır; üç değer açıkça verilse de aralarındaki dilbilgisel ve anlamsal bağ ayrıntılandırılmaz.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık ışık, açığa çıkarma ve belirginleştirme değerlerini yan yana verir; daha geniş bir kapsamı desteklemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir kişiyi yakına getirme, seçme ve başkalarından ayırarak ona özel bir yer verme yönlerini birlikte taşır. Yaratıcının kulunu seçmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Uydurma çerçevesi kaynak sözünün suçlayıcı yorumunu doğru verir, ancak bu anlam genel bir eylem değildir. Yalnızca bir bildiri parçasının kişinin kendisince derlenip uydurulduğunu öne süren belirli soru kalıbında geçerlidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü öne eğilmiş ayakta duruşu, elleri dizlere koymayı, dizler üzerinde yüzüstü kapanmayı ve yere kapanmayı birlikte verir. Toplanma ise bağımsız bir toplama eylemi değil, bedenin bükülüp kendi üzerine çekilmesini açıklayan yön olarak anlaşılmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalda temel olarak bir seyi kesmeyi, ozellikle de kokunden ayirip koparmayi verir. Deve horgucunun kokunden kesilmesi ve igdis edilmis kisinin organlarinin alinmasi bu cekirdegin ozel uygulamalari olarak ayni sinir icinde kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Duyusal kesip ayirma cekirdektir; korkak adam ya da ayri kap anlamlari bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın kesme adi hem de horguc ve igdis etme baglamlari vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir kokten kesme ekseninde ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi bulundugu kokten veya taban bagindan keserek ayirma, yok etme ya da bu kesilmis halde bulunma anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel hareket, nesneyi kokunden veya asil bagindan kesip ayirmaktir.
Horgucun kokunden alinmasi ve igdis etmede organlarin alinmasi bu kesmenin beden uzerindeki ozel kullanimlaridir.
Kesme eyleminin sonucu olarak kesilmis horguclu hayvan veya kesilmis kisi nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak bicimde kesme anlamini verir ve bunu kokunden koparma sinirina tasir. Horgucun kesilmesi, her sey icin kesip ayirma fiili ve igdis edilmis kisi ornekleri ayni fiziksel ayirma cekirdegini destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel kesme cekirdegini ve horguc ya da beden organi gibi kokten koparma uygulamalarini birlikte karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Kok bagindan kesme, ayirma ve kesilmis sonucun hepsini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin kendisi soz konusu oldugunda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme eylemini ve kokten ayirma sinirini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Horgucu ya da bedensel uzvu alinmis kisi veya hayvan nitelenirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme sonucunda ortaya cikan durumu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuyu dali, kesilme sonucunu degil belirli bir su cukurunu adlandirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da ayrilmislik veya acilmis derinlik tasavvuruyla temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir eylem ve bu eylemin sonucu olan kokten kesilmis durumu anlatir; komsu dal ise kaplanmamis ya da derin bir kuyunun adidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dogrudan birini veya toplulugu ustun gelerek asmayi verir; guzellikte baskin cikma bunun belirgin bir kullanimidir. Kesme imgesi burada fiziksel degil, benzeriyle ayni duzeyde olma bagini koparan mecazi ustunluk olarak kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel kesmeye degil, kisinin veya toplulugun denklerini geride birakan ustunluguna aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Topluluğa karsi ustun gelme ve kadinin guzellikle diger kadinlari gecmesi birlikte verilir; tanim bu baglamlari genellestirir ama fiziksel kesmeye tasimaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin ya da seyin denklerini ustunlukla geride birakmasi, ozellikle guzellik veya baska bir nitelikle onlari asmasi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, rakip veya denk sayilan kisileri ustun gelerek asmadir.
Kadinin guzelligiyle diger kadinlari geride birakmasi ozel ve sik vurgulanan kullanimdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali ustun gelme anlaminda birlestirir. Bazilari bunu guzellikte baskin cikma ornegiyle, bazilari da topluluga karsi galip olma ifadesiyle verir; fiziksel kesme yalniz mecazi aciklama olarak kalir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Topluluk veya denkler uzerinde nitelik, guzellik ya da benzer bir sebeple baskin cikma baglamlarina uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ustun gelme, denkleri asma ve guzellik ozel kullanimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadinlar arasinda guzellik ustunlugu anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Guzellik sebebiyle ustun gelme ayrintisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kisinin bir toplulugu asmasi veya yenmesi baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluga karsi baskin cikma anlamini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda kesme mecazi bir aciklama olup asil anlam ustun gelmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda asil anlam duyusal olarak kokten kesip ayirmadir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bir esitleme veya baglilik durumunun ortadan kalkmasi fikrine temas eder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi giyilen ve bedeni icine alarak saran bir giysiyi verir; zirh adi olarak kullanimi da giyilen koruyucu nesne sinirindadir. Bu dal, mızrak yuvasi veya ev ortasi gibi ic bosluk adlariyla karistirilmamalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal giyilen, bedeni saran esyaya aittir; soket, kuyu veya genel kap anlamlari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin giysi adi ve zirh adi birlikte bulunur; tanim saran giyilebilir nesne sinirini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bedeni icine alip saran giyilebilir nesne, bunun cogulu ve zırh adi olarak kullanilan koruyucu giysi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bedeni icine alan ve uzerinde tasinan giysidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar giyilen nesneyi ortak kabul eder ve onun bedeni sarmasi aciklamasini verir. Ek olarak zırh adi olarak kullanilmasi, giysi cekirdeginin koruyucu bir alt turu gibi belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Giyilen ana nesne ve zırh adi olarak koruyucu giysi kullanimi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni icine alma, giyilme ve zırh alt turunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de icine alma ve sarma goruntusuyle temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedene giyilen nesneyi anlatir; komsu dal mızrak ucu, goz, ev veya boynuz gibi yerlerdeki giris boslugunu anlatir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mızrak ucuna giren sap yuvasi, goz cukuru, evin ortasi, hurma tomurcugunun ici ve boynuzdaki yer gibi icine girilen veya icte kalan yerleri birlikte verir. Bu, bagimsiz kuyu ya da giyilen giysi degil, belirli nesnelerdeki giris veya ic bosluk adidir.

Goz cukuru, evin ortasi, tomurcugun ici ve boynuzdaki yer ayni ic bolum tasavvuruyla kullanilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar mızrak ucu yuvasi etrafinda ortaklasir ve bunu icine girilen yer olarak aciklar. Tek kaynakli ek ornekler goz, ev, hurma tomurcugu ve boynuzdaki ic bolumleri ayni sekle baglar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deri parcalardan yapilan toprak tasima sepetini ve et, parca et veya eritilmis yag konan iskembe turu kabi birlikte verir. Ses veya iri yanlilik anlamlari acikca bu kapsamin disinda tutulmalidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskin bolumu insanlarin hurmayi asılamasini ve bunun zamanini verir. Bir kaynakta zamanin hasat zamaniyla yaklastirilmasi bulunsa da dal yalniz genel kesme anlamina indirgenemez; tanim hurma isleri baglamina bagli kalmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hurma asilama isi ve mevsimiyle sinirlidir; genel kesme veya genel tarim zamani olarak genisletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam tamlama ve baglama baglidir; tanim hurma isini yalın kok anlamina cevirmeden verir.

Bir aktarim zaman anlamini kesim zamaniyla yaklastirir, fakat dal hurma isleri baglaminda kalir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hurma asilama eylemini ve bunun zamani olarak kullanimi birlikte verir. Zamanin hurma kesim donemine yaklastirildigi aktarim, cekirdegi genis bir kesme anlamina degil hurma islerinin mevsimine baglar.
